**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites, all to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.**

Left `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` alone. Its header says edits are lost on upgrade. Two `db.query` calls still live there. That needs an upstream fix or a wrapper.

Also left `cache.query` untouched. Different object, not part of this.

No tests or `package.json` in the repo. Nothing to run.
